findings.current: A friend it could neither play with nor speak to, but who had never left its side.
findings.defect: The source says they could not run and play together and could not communicate. The English drops the running image and narrows inability to communicate to inability to speak.
findings.rationale: The Korean explicitly says 함께 뛰며 놀 수도 없고, 말도 통하지 않지만: they could not run and play together or communicate, though the friend was always beside it.
findings.replacement: A friend it could never run and play with or communicate with, but who had always been by its side.

findings.current: That young human bastard named Yayul Cheon had less fear than any living creature it had ever seen.
findings.defect: The English omits the explicit transition that this realization came the next day.
findings.rationale: The source states 그리고 다음 날 before the guardian spirit’s realization, marking the next day as the timing of this beat.
findings.replacement: And the next day, the guardian spirit realized that the young human bastard named Yayul Cheon had less fear than any living creature it had ever seen.

summary: Two minor omissions: the English drops a physical image in the White Tiger’s memory and the explicit next-day transition.
